title: Vincent K NDE 4936
content: About five minutes into my recovery period from a stress-test on an exercise bike, my eyesight began to cloud over, starting from the outside corners. I lost my balance and had a change in cardiac reading, which alerted the nurse. Then I was in a 'place' in the presence of other persons, who were smiling and very luminous, but with a soft light. I don't remember faces, but I remember the benevolence of the way they looked at me. We were floating without the actual sensation of floating. We were just nowhere, which gave a floating feeling, as there was no limit in space, no ground, and no soft sky overhead. There was no notion of time either, which is strange. It was impossible to say whether it lasted one minute or eternally, as time really does not exist. There was no feeling of time passing. I felt intense happiness, or rather well-being. I heard someone calling me at a certain point. I could hear my name, and that is when I opened my eyes and saw three heads above me, and the aggressive neon light. I did not recognize anyone, and it took me some seconds to realize that I was in the hospital. I was sorry I had been recalled to this place, and I wanted to go back. I felt a great sadness at coming back to reality, and then uncontrollable laughter on realizing the experience I had been through. On seeing the exercise-bike and myself lying down, I asked the nurse to confirm that I should have been on the bike. She explained that I had passed out. She had caught me as I fell and then, with the help of the doctors, carried me to the bed and tried to resuscitate me with slaps. They had been quite worried, especially the nurse.

arrival.other_being_detail: In a 'place' in the presence of other persons who were smiling and very luminous with a soft light; faces not remembered; benevolent demeanor.

environment.environment_other_detail: They were 'just nowhere' with no limit in space, no ground, and no soft sky overhead; gave a floating feeling.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Occurred during recovery period after a stress-test on an exercise bike; passed out with change in cardiac reading; staff attempted resuscitation with slaps.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard someone calling his name, then opened eyes to see three heads above him and neon light in hospital.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel/light described; directly 'in a place' with other luminous persons; then recalled by hearing name and returned to hospital awareness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Floating/nowhere environment described as having no limit in space, no ground, and no sky overhead; no sensation of floating but a floating feeling.
